theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+1.34%) and Utilities (+0.78%) led the market today, while Energy (-2.01%) and Consumer Staples (-0.81%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.55% versus +0.00% for defensives and -0.44% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.18% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +0.04%. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +1.16%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 4.73% to 17.52, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.16% to $4,076.70, crude oil was little changed at $100.19, and bitcoin gained 0.01% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
